title: TN Whiskey Condo - quick ride to Broadway/BNA
description:
Welcome to Nashville where the music is loud and the drinks are strong! Our condo is the sanctuary you need between the sights, sounds, and tastes of Music City....to help make your Nashville visit as smooth as TN Whiskey!

-NO SMOKING
-NO PARTIES
